name: fishball-shared
//: A library, not a DSH plugin (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1): no `dsh` field, so no bundle, row, client or service, and it never appears on a Plugins page. It is the Fishball side's library (requirements 1.40, design §1.0b row 5): it holds only modules Fishball-side packages use (fishball-core and fishball-ui; fishball-board may join, R-ARCH-08), imports no other V3 package, and ships inside their tarballs through bundleDependencies (V3 publishes nothing to a registry). The DSH side has its own library, dsh-connector-shared; no module is shared across the sides.
description: The Fishball side's library: the fishball-core / fishball-ui seam, file helpers and the OAuth browser client core's Connect runs on (./oauth-client).
